additional_info.body:
Hi,
Is it possible to check logs on the charger n. 170002732 between 4:45:59 p.m. and 4:47:30 p.m. (CU Time) and at  5:00:00 (CU time) of 9 of August?
A customer tried to charge by using IPlanet App, but the recharge was always a 0 recharge. It seems to be for disconnected cable, can you give us a feedback on this?
Thank you in advance

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0443716-DC/Si-D/IT-[MP / R9 170002732] Issue with the charger CRM:02684000488
additional_info.body:
Dear Luigi,
I am reaching out from the Expert Services team in regards of ticket
ID0443716.
The ticket is opened for a request of logs analysis on charger
MP/R9 170002732
in date 09.08.2025.
Here are the results of my analysis at the timestamps provided:
At 2025-08-09T16:32:16 the charging session is authorized remotely via app on ConnectorID 2 (Chademo)
At 2025-08-09T16:32:23 DC2 (CCS) is plugged in ConnectorID: 1.
The session of course fails. This is the current configuration from Siemens Backend:
At 2025-08-09T16:45:59, a new session is remotely authorized via App, this time on ConnectorID 3 (AC). DC2 is then connected (CCS - ConnectorID: 1). Session of course fails.
At 2025-08-09T17:09:13 again, the remotestarttrasaction arrives for ConnectorID 3 (AC), but DC2 is plugged in.
Again at 2025-08-09T17:23:37
The issue here was clearly a wrong behavior of the end user to use the app and the charger. If possible, please instruct the end user on how to use the app and authenticate.
If any change needs to be done in terms of ConnectorID on the charger, please reach out to the colleagues from Siemens Italy.
I will proceed to close this ticket.
Thank you and have a good evening!
With kind regards,
